name: Jo — fifteen hours in, and reading about competitions
summary: Finished her course last spring, bought a low-B straight away, about 15 hours and 30 flights on it. Flies two or three times a month and loves it. Already thinking about long cross-country flights and entering a competition next season. Would rather just fly a new wing than spend time relearning one.
why_this_persona: The clearly-not-yet case, and the only persona that exercises the single numeric gate in this rubric. Also the combination-gate case: her ambitions alone are fine, but paired with a skills score below 55 they fire 'ambition_without_readiness'. Her enthusiasm must be visible in the output as something to build on rather than something to apologise for.

notes: Computed skills 47.4, psychological 60.9, total 53.9, no bonus.

'airtime_under_20h' is the only numeric gate in this rubric. It is set at the floor where the two quantified sources agree — below USHPA P3's 20 hours of solo airtime and far below paragliding24.ch's annual-hours framing — rather than at either source's own figure. See meta.design_decisions 'v1-fewer-numeric-gates-than-a-to-low-b' in config/scoring/low-b-to-mid-b.json. A reviewer checking the rubric's restraint should note she would NOT be gated for her flight count (30, below P3's 90) or her time on the current wing (15 hours), both of which are scored instead.

'ambition_without_readiness' fires because her skills score is 47.4, below the 55 trigger, AND she has ticked longer_xc and competitions. Neither half fires it alone — persona 06 has the same ambitions with strong skills and is not gated by it, and personas 07 and 09 have thin-ish skills without the listed ambitions and are not gated by it either.

Negative check on knowledge/disagreements.md point 9, the important one for this persona: her result must not read as a telling-off for being ambitious. The gate message explicitly says the goals are fine and names the groundwork as the gap, and 'xc_skills_on_current_wing' is asserted present so she gets an encouraging, concrete route to the thing she actually wants.
Gates short-circuit, so 'rules_expected' is empty even though she would also fail critical_check_floor on reading_the_day (0.2) and active_piloting (0.45).

'improve_currency' must not fire: she flies two or three times a month, which is good. Her problem is total experience, not currency — the two are separate questions with separate weights, per knowledge/disagreements.md point 2, and the suggestions must respect that distinction.
